Phoned in the morning in to be told there were no appts and to take her to A&E. I asked was I being told to take her to A&E because it was an emergency or because they had no appts. The receptionist then said take her to A&E because it could be sepsis. I hadn't given any detailed information about my mums eye problems, certainly not enough for someone who isn't medically trained to triage it. Inwasnt asked any triage questions at all. Saying go to A&E is awful, we are told repeatedly not to do this as A&E are strained so much. We ended up paying privately for mum to see a GP today. Mum didn't need to go to A&E but we were told she should have been seen today had it been triaged. There's no triage system in place at this surgery, clearly all appts go first thing in the morning and no emergency appts available for the rest of the day. This really needs addressing as many surgeries now have effective triage systems in place so proper information can be taken and decisions made on the basis of need, not rather who phones up at 8am. Our experience today was awful and worrying.

I suggest patients contact  CQC and fill out their feedback forms otherwise nothing will
